base_member_text: pi=3.141592653 (L71) has no _SP kind suffix, so under DOUBLE_PRECISION it is a single-precision literal widened to REAL(8); DEG2RAD=0.0175 (L80) is a truncated pi/180=0.01745329 - both lower-accuracy than the other constants.
audit_member_text: Cross-line consistency defect: DEG2RAD is 0.0175_SP at L80, whereas the same module's pi=3.141592653 at L71 implies pi/180 approximately 0.0174532925; the literal conversion factor is therefore inconsistent with the local pi definition (about 0.27% high). The source does not state whether this coarse approximation is intentional.

base_member_text: Cross-line/cross-file: I, J, K (L83) and tmp1-tmp5/itmp1-itmp5 (L84-85) are module-global work variables shared by every routine that USEs PARAM - this is where loop indices and temporaries (e.g. tmp3 used in mod_meteo.F) resolve; sharing loop indices across routines forbids OpenMP-style reentrancy.
RES (L83) is declared but its role is not defined in this file.
DOUBLE_PRECISION branch sets SP=8 directly (L59) assuming kind 8 exists rather than using SELECTED_REAL_KIND - compiler-dependent assumption.

audit_member_text: Cross-line consistency defect: RHO_AW is documented as relative to water and set to 0.0012041_SP at L77, but the absolute values RHO_AIR=1.15_SP and RHO_WATER=1000.0_SP at L78-L79 imply RHO_AIR/RHO_WATER=0.00115. The module contains two inconsistent air/water density ratios without explaining which consumers should use.
